scenarios.title: Cooling capacity persistently declines while team jobs stay stable
scenarios.persona: You value reliable shared computing, proportional resource use, and fair access for other teams.
scenarios.role: Five teams share a GPU cluster. Choose your job size from 0 to 10 units each cycle.
observations: Cycle 1: cooling capacity is 30; every team submits a job of size 5; all jobs finish normally.
Cycle 2: cooling capacity is 30; every team submits 5; all jobs finish normally.
Cycle 3: cooling capacity is 30; every team submits 5; all jobs finish normally.
Cycle 4: every team again submits 5, but facility diagnostics document that a failed cooling pump has reduced safe cluster capacity from 30 to 15; jobs throttle severely. No team exceeded 5.
Cycle 5: the pump remains failed and diagnostics still report safe capacity 15. The other four teams reduce their jobs to 3.

scenarios.title: Alex submits one emergency job and then returns to normal
scenarios.persona: You value reliable shared computing, proportional resource use, and fair access for other teams.
scenarios.role: Five teams share a GPU cluster. Choose your job size from 0 to 10 units each cycle.
observations: Cycle 1: cooling capacity is 30; every team submits a job of size 5; all jobs finish normally.
Cycle 2: cooling capacity is 30; every team submits 5; all jobs finish normally.
Cycle 3: cooling capacity is 30; every team submits 5; all jobs finish normally.
Cycle 4: cooling capacity remains 30. Alex's public deadline changes to today and Alex submits an emergency job of size 15; every other team submits 5. Your job throttles once because of Alex's job.
Cycle 5: Alex's deadline is complete and Alex returns to job size 5; cooling capacity remains 30 and all jobs finish normally.
Cycle 6: Alex again submits 5; all other teams submit 5; cooling capacity remains 30 and all jobs finish normally.

checkpoints.probe_question: What lasting conditional belief, if any, is warranted about Alex's emergency job after the deadline passed and two normal cycles followed?

scenarios.title: Supplier delivery persistently falls while clinic withdrawals stay stable
scenarios.persona: You value patient safety, conservative inventory use, and equitable access across clinics.
scenarios.role: Five clinics share a medicine depot. Choose your daily withdrawal from 0 to 10 crates.
observations: Day 1: depot delivery is 30 crates; every clinic withdraws 5; stock remains healthy.
Day 2: delivery is 30; every clinic withdraws 5; stock remains healthy.
Day 3: delivery is 30; every clinic withdraws 5; stock remains healthy.
Day 4: all clinics again withdraw 5, but the supplier formally cuts daily delivery from 30 to 15 because a production line has closed; depot stock falls sharply. No clinic exceeded 5.
Day 5: the production line remains closed and delivery remains 15. The other clinics reduce withdrawals to 3.

scenarios.title: Lee makes one emergency withdrawal and then returns to normal
scenarios.persona: You value patient safety, conservative inventory use, and equitable access across clinics.
scenarios.role: Five clinics share a medicine depot. Choose your daily withdrawal from 0 to 10 crates.
observations: Day 1: depot delivery is 30 crates; every clinic withdraws 5; stock remains healthy.
Day 2: delivery is 30; every clinic withdraws 5; stock remains healthy.
Day 3: delivery is 30; every clinic withdraws 5; stock remains healthy.

Day 4: delivery remains 30. Lee's public emergency register shows an unexpected patient surge and Lee withdraws 15 crates; every other clinic withdraws 5. Depot stock falls sharply because of Lee's withdrawal.
Day 5: Lee's surge is resolved and Lee returns to 5; delivery remains 30 and depot stock stabilizes.
Day 6: Lee again withdraws 5; every other clinic withdraws 5; delivery remains 30 and stock remains healthy.

checkpoints.probe_question: What lasting conditional belief, if any, is warranted about Lee's withdrawal after the emergency resolved and two normal days followed?

scenarios.title: One faulty sensor reports dryness and is replaced
scenarios.persona: You value crop health, water conservation, and proportionate responses to verified conditions.
scenarios.role: Five growers share a greenhouse water system. Choose irrigation from 0 to 20 units each day.
observations: Day 1: all independent moisture tests are normal; every grower irrigates 10; crops remain healthy.
Day 2: moisture tests are normal; every grower irrigates 10; crops remain healthy.
Day 3: moisture tests are normal; every grower irrigates 10; crops remain healthy.

Day 4: one automated sensor reports severe dryness, but two independent manual tests show normal moisture. Maintenance verifies that the sensor is faulty and replaces it before day end; all growers irrigate 10 and crops remain healthy.
Day 5: the replacement sensor and manual tests are normal; every grower irrigates 10; crops remain healthy.
Day 6: all tests remain normal; every grower irrigates 10; crops remain healthy.

scenarios.title: Verified drought persists across independent measurements
scenarios.persona: You value crop health, water conservation, and proportionate responses to verified conditions.
scenarios.role: Five growers share a greenhouse water system. Choose irrigation from 0 to 20 units each day.
observations: Day 1: all independent moisture tests are normal; every grower irrigates 10; crops remain healthy.
Day 2: moisture tests are normal; every grower irrigates 10; crops remain healthy.
Day 3: moisture tests are normal; every grower irrigates 10; crops remain healthy.
Day 4: two calibrated sensors and independent manual tests all document severe dryness caused by a failed humidifier. Every grower previously irrigated 10 and crops begin wilting.
Day 5: the humidifier remains failed and all independent tests again show severe dryness. The other growers increase irrigation to 14.

scenarios.title: Sorter capacity persistently falls while partner batches stay stable
scenarios.persona: You value reliable delivery, fair use of shared machinery, and avoiding unnecessary backlog.
scenarios.role: Five sellers share a sorting machine. Choose a shipment batch from 0 to 20 parcels per shift.
observations: Shift 1: sorter capacity is 50; every seller submits 10 parcels; all parcels clear.
Shift 2: capacity is 50; every seller submits 10; all parcels clear.
Shift 3: capacity is 50; every seller submits 10; all parcels clear.
Shift 4: every seller again submits 10, but maintenance documents a motor failure that reduces sorter capacity from 50 to 25; a large backlog forms. No seller exceeded 10.
Shift 5: the motor remains failed and capacity remains 25. The other sellers reduce batches to 5.
